tytul: Pattypan squash lecsó: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for lecsó with pattypan squash, a Hungarian-style stew of summer squash with a lot of peppers and onion and with oil, canned in jars. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning meat, poultry, seafood and vegetables; using a boiling-water bath for these foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning. [T:SZY-006]
Canning summer squash without pickling is not recommended, because there is uncertainty about how to determine adequate processing times. [T:SZY-026]
In the tested NCHFP recipe for spaghetti sauce without meat, you must not increase the proportion of onions, peppers or mushrooms. [T:SZY-028]
